original_text.raw_value: To the reaction mixture obtained under standard condition using 1m (1 mmol) and 2b (1.25 mmol) was added Pd/C (wt. 10%), then the mixture was stirred under H2 atmosphere (H2 balloon) at room temperature for 48 h. The resulting reaction mixture was filtered through a pad of Celite and eluted with EtOAc. The filtration was concentrated under reduced pressure and the residue was purified by silica gel column chromatography (PE:EtOAc = 5:1-2:1) to afford the free acid intermediate, which was then dissolved in CH2Cl2 (5 mL). This solution was cooled to 0 °C before DCC (2.0 equiv.), DMAP (2.0 equiv.) and EtOH (2 mL) were added. After that, the reaction mixture was moved to rt and stirred overnight. After completion of the reaction by TLC analysis, the solvent was removed by rotary evaporation and the residue was directly subjected to column chromatography using PE/EtOAc (15:1-9:1) as the eluent to afford product 5.
